proposal.rationale: In § 1910.157(c)(4), 'except during use' is an explicit exception embedded in the baseline requirement that extinguishers be kept in their designated places at all times (C0001). Under the relationship pass, an explicit exception must be emitted as a separate exception unit qualifying its baseline rule with relation exception and modality not_stated.

context_quotes: (4) The employer shall assure that portable fire extinguishers are maintained in a fully charged and operable condition and kept in their designated places at all times except during use.
fields.summary: Portable fire extinguishers are not required to be kept in their designated places during use, acting as an exception to the requirement that they be kept in designated places at all times.

issues.quote: Where extinguishers are provided but are not intended for employee use and the employer has an emergency action plan and a fire prevention plan that meet the requirements of 29 CFR 1910.38 and 29 CFR 1910.39 respectively, then only the requirements of paragraphs (e) and (f) of this section apply.
issues.rationale: This scoping limitation restricting application to paragraphs (e) and (f) is already represented in the scope_text and scope_quotes of C0001.
